parameters.name: CheckIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the check items.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: A set of cloud product instance IDs that require validation.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the whitelist rule.

>  You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to query the IDs of whitelist rules.
